definition: σάκκος  also written σάκος, -ου, ὁ  (cf. Heb. שַׂק, which it renders in LXX), __1. a coarse cloth, sackcloth, usually made of hair: Rev.6:12.  __2. Anything made of sackcloth;  __(a) a sack (Gen.42:25, al.);  __(b) a garment of sackcloth, expressive of mourning or penitence: Mat.11:21, Luk.10:13, Rev.11:3.† (AS)
